name: Bullet Internet
summary: Sydney dialup + ADSL ISP (est. 2000 by SIS Group Pty Ltd, ACN 079 466 274); absorbed Dragon Net (~2006); folded into SIS Group (Amaze) by 2017.

events.details: Dialup + ADSL (SIS Group Pty Ltd, ACN 079 466 274). Earliest Wayback capture 2 Apr 2001 (bullet.net.au).
Folded into SIS Group (Amaze). Retail bullet.net.au homepage served content through early 2016 (last 200 capture Mar 2016); from 2017 the domain returned only 301 redirects.
source: Wayback CDX: 200 homepage through Mar 2016, 301 from 2017
